app_name.description: The name of the application displayed in the window title.

ui_scale_multiplier.description: Global scale multiplier for the UI font and window dimensions.

preload_modules.description: If enabled, preloads all available modules at startup.

skip_import_validation.description: If enabled, skips import validation during module loading.

enabled.description: Show or hide the splash screen on startup.

image.description: Path to the image displayed on the splash screen.

size.description: Size in pixels of the splash screen window.

thickness.description: Thickness of the splash screen border.

path.description: Path to the application window icon.

enabled.description: Request authentication/profile selection at application startup.

default_mode.description: Default profile mode proposed during login.

theme_name.description: Visual theme loaded at application startup.

mascot.description: Show the assistant mascot on the UI.

enabled.description: Enable global debugging mode and debug logs.

log_mkdocs.description: Show logs related to the MkDocs documentation server.

vsync.description: Enable vertical synchronization to prevent screen tearing.

minimize_to_tray.description: Minimize the application to the system tray instead of the taskbar.

show_console.description: Show the system console in the background (Windows only).

working_directory.description: Default root folder used to load and save pipelines and scripts.

default_pipeline.description: Path to the pipeline loaded by default on startup.

default_automation_script.description: Path to the default automation script loaded.

show_loader_on_startup.description: Show startup dialog to select a pipeline or script if none is specified.

default_pipeline_folder.description: Default directory where pipeline/layout JSON files are located.

default_scripts_folder.description: Default directory where automation script JSON files are located.

rotation.description: Rotation angle (in degrees) applied to the video feed of IDS cameras.
Rotation angle (in degrees) applied to the video feed of Alvium cameras.
